Strategy: Reward bins whose residual sits in the middle-low slice of the current spread, between 30 and 50 percent of the way from the tightest to the loosest bin, so the choice adapts to the distribution instead of fixed absolute leftover sizes.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    mn = min(bins)
    mx = max(bins)
    return [-(r - item) + (20 if mx > mn and (r - mn) * 10 >= (mx - mn) * 3 and (r - mn) * 10 <= (mx - mn) * 5 else 0) for r in bins]
```
